name: Escape with a Lucky Block
desc:
Welcome to Escape with a Lucky Block! 😈

🍀 Go further for better luck!
📦 Grab a Lucky Block and run back alive!
🤖 Escape the animatronics chasing you!
🧠 Collect Brainrots to earn Cash!
⚡ Train your speed with treadmills and trails!

💸 Your Brainrots earn Cash offline!
